    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id

SELECT

    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count

    c.risk_weighted_assets

WITH group_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 0) AS total_exposure_amount
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id AND re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON re.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
group_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = capital_snapshot.institution_id
    )
)
SELECT
    ge.exposure_group_id,
    ge.group_name,
    ge.total_exposure_amount,
    ge.total_exposure_amount * 1.0 / gc.net_capital AS exposure_ratio
FROM group_exposure ge
JOIN group_capital gc ON ge.institution_id = gc.institution_id
WHERE gc.net_capital > 0
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ind.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonperforming_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS nonperforming_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE rc.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
    FROM risk_classification rc2
    WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
GROUP BY ind.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY nonperforming_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name
ORDER BY
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    capital_snapshot c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
WHERE
    c.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
    AND c.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_en,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_en IN ('Normal', 'Special Mention')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
WHERE
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000.0
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
  AND pi.status = '已执行'
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

WITH institution_payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pi.institution_id,
        SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount
    FROM payment_instruction pi
    JOIN account acc ON pi.intended_payee_account_id = acc.account_id
    JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
    JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
    WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
    GROUP BY pi.institution_id
),
all_institution_payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        pi.institution_id,
        SUM(pi.instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount
    FROM payment_instruction pi
    GROUP BY pi.institution_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        COALESCE(ips.institution_id, aips.institution_id) AS institution_id,
        COALESCE(ips.total_instruction_amount, 0) AS restricted_amount,
        aips.total_instruction_amount AS total_amount
    FROM all_institution_payment_stats aips
    LEFT JOIN institution_payment_stats ips ON aips.institution_id = ips.institution_id
    JOIN institution i ON aips.institution_id = i.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    restricted_amount AS 违规流入金额,
    total_amount AS 指令金额合计,
    CASE
        WHEN total_amount = 0 THEN 0.0
        ELSE restricted_amount * 1.0 / total_amount
    END AS 占比
FROM combined
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on,
    wp.actual_termination_on
FROM
    wealth_product wp
JOIN
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE
    ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

WITH GuarantorParties AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_commitment_count
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
BorrowerParties AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_agreement_count
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
MutualParties AS (
    SELECT
        gp.guarantor_party_id AS party_id
    FROM GuarantorParties gp
    INNER JOIN BorrowerParties bp ON gp.guarantor_party_id = bp.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT
    mp.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    gp.guarantee_commitment_count,
    bp.borrower_agreement_count
FROM MutualParties mp
JOIN party p ON mp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN GuarantorParties gp ON mp.party_id = gp.guarantor_party_id
JOIN BorrowerParties bp ON mp.party_id = bp.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY gp.guarantee_commitment_count DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    c.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog c ON pe.payment_type = c.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = '已清算'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ind_reg.sector_name_zh AS borrower_registered_industry,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS agreement_target_industry,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind_reg ON op.industry_code = ind_reg.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code
WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    from_holder.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    to_holder.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM
    payment_event pe
JOIN
    account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN
    account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN
    account_holder from_holder ON from_acc.account_id = from_holder.account_id
JOIN
    account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id
JOIN
    party_relation pr ON
        (pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id)
        OR
        (pr.source_party_id = to_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = from_holder.party_id)
WHERE
    pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
ORDER BY
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name
HAVING
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN institution i ON acc_from.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) >= 50
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON pp.employment_sector = isec.sector_code
WHERE isec.risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    c.subject_id AS record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    c.event_date,
    c.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(c.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_diff
FROM
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 c
JOIN
    institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    c.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY
    days_diff DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_agreement_status
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cf.facility_id = sa.institution_id -- Note: This join logic seems flawed based on schema. Let's re-evaluate.
-- Re-evaluating the relationship:
-- loan_drawdown -> credit_agreement (via agreement_id)
-- credit_agreement -> credit_facility (via facility_id)
-- credit_facility -> security_agreement? No direct link.
-- However, secured_obligation links security_agreement to credit_agreement.
-- So: loan_drawdown -> credit_agreement -> secured_obligation -> security_agreement

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rank_in_institution
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_in_institution
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rank_in_institution = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH LoanBalanceWithIndustry AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ca.target_industry_code,
        isec.sector_name_zh
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON ca.target_industry_code = isec.sector_code
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        sector_name_zh,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sector_name_zh ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) as rank_num
    FROM LoanBalanceWithIndustry
)
SELECT 
    sector_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_num
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rank_num <= 3
ORDER BY sector_name_zh ASC, rank_num ASC;

WITH daily_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_counts
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    avg_bal.avg_principal_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal_balance) AS excess_amount
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            ca2.institution_id,
            AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
        FROM
            loan_drawdown ld2
        JOIN
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
        JOIN
            credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
        GROUP BY
            ca2.institution_id
    ) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE
    lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY
    excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    sa.security_type = '第三方保证'
    AND sa.security_id NOT IN (
        SELECT cl.security_id
        FROM collateral_link cl
        WHERE cl.security_id IS NOT NULL
    )
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'

        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 2

),
all_transactions AS (

        to_account_id
    FROM payment_with_institution
),
related_transactions AS (
    SELECT

    FROM all_transactions at
    INNER JOIN account_holder ah_from ON at.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
    INNER JOIN account_holder ah_to ON at.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
    INNER JOIN party_relation pr ON ah_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id
                                AND ah_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id

    WHERE ah_from.effective_from <= at.business_date
      AND (ah_from.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_from.effective_to >= at.business_date)
      AND ah_to.effective_from <= at.business_date
      AND (ah_to.effective_to IS NULL OR ah_to.effective_to >= at.business_date)

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN managed_asset pa ON ld.loan_account_id = pa.asset_id -- Assuming loan account links to managed asset for industry info, or borrower party
    -- Note: The schema links loan_drawdown to credit_agreement, which links to borrower_party_id.
    -- managed_asset has obligor_party_id. 
    -- However, loan_drawdown doesn't directly link to managed_asset or party in a simple way for industry.
    -- Let's look at credit_agreement -> borrower_party_id.
    -- party -> person_profile/organization_profile -> industry_code?
    -- organization_profile has industry_code.
    
    -- Let's re-evaluate the path:
    -- loan_drawdown -> credit_agreement (agreement_id)
    -- credit_agreement -> borrower_party_id
    -- party (party_id = borrower_party_id)
    -- organization_profile (party_id = borrower_party_id) -> industry_code
    
    -- But wait, loan_drawdown has loan_account_id. 
    -- Is there a direct link to industry? 
    -- managed_asset has industry_code and obligor_party_id.
    -- loan_drawdown doesn't have obligor_party_id.
    -- credit_agreement has borrower_party_id.
    
    -- Let's use credit_agreement to get the borrower party, then organization_profile for industry.
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(total_principal_balance) AS grand_total
    FROM loan_balances
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.industry_code,
        lb.total_principal_balance,
        SUM(lb.total_principal_balance) * 1.0 / tb.grand_total AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM loan_balances lb
    CROSS JOIN total_balance tb
    GROUP BY lb.industry_code, lb.total_principal_balance, tb.grand_total
    -- Note: SQLite doesn't support window functions like SUM() OVER() in older versions, 
    -- but standard SQL does. Assuming modern SQLite.
    -- However, to be safe and strictly follow "cumulative", we need to order by balance desc.
    -- Let's use a subquery or window function if available. 
    -- Since the prompt asks for "high to low", we need to order the aggregation.
)
-- Re-doing with Window Function for clarity and correctness in SQLite 3.25+
SELECT 
    isc.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    ri.total_principal_balance,
    ri.cumulative_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
        SUM(SUM(lbs.principal_balance)) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_principal_balance) FROM loan_balances) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id

WITH institution_credit AS (

    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE' -- Assuming only active or relevant agreements count, but prompt doesn't specify status filter. Usually 'all' implies all records unless specified. Let's assume all records in credit_agreement.
),
all_credit_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        SUM(contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM institution_credit
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
related_party_ids AS (
    -- Get all parties that are related to any party via a relation where source is the party itself
    -- The prompt says "关联关系以客户作为关联发起方的记录为准" (Related relationships are based on records where the customer is the initiator/source).
    -- And "非关联客户（不存在非‘非关联方’关联关系）" -> Non-related customers are those who DO NOT have any relation record where they are the source, EXCEPT if the relation type is 'Non-Related Party' (if such a type exists).
    -- However, looking at relation_type_catalog, we don't see the data. But typically, if a party has ANY relation record as source, they are "related" in the graph sense.
    -- The prompt says "不存在非‘非关联方’关联关系". This phrasing is tricky. It likely means:
    -- 1. Identify all parties that appear as source_party_id in party_relation.
    -- 2. If a party has NO such records, they are non-related.
    -- 3. OR, if a party has records, but all of them are of type 'Non-Related Party' (or similar), they are non-related.
    -- Given the ambiguity of "非‘非关联方’", it usually implies excluding those who have "Related Party" relationships.
    -- Let's assume: A customer is "related" if they have at least one record in party_relation as source_party_id.
    -- A customer is "non-related" if they have NO records in party_relation as source_party_id.
    
    SELECT DISTINCT source_party_id
    FROM party_relation
),
non_related_parties AS (
    SELECT party_id
    FROM party
    WHERE party_id NOT IN (SELECT source_party_id FROM party_relation)
),
non_related_credit_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM institution_credit ca
    JOIN non_related_parties nrp ON ca.borrower_party_id = nrp.party_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)

    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) AS non_related_amount,

    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, eg.institution_id
),
InstitutionCapital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
),
ThresholdCheck AS (
    SELECT
        ge.exposure_group_id,
        ge.group_name,
        ge.institution_id,
        ge.total_exposure,
        ic.net_capital,
        (ge.total_exposure * 1.0 / ic.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
    FROM GroupExposure ge
    JOIN InstitutionCapital ic ON ge.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT
    exposure_group_id,
    group_name,
    total_exposure,
    net_capital,
    concentration_ratio
FROM ThresholdCheck
WHERE concentration_ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE
    ca.status = '已到期'
    AND ld.status = '正常'
ORDER BY
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS interval_days
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    payment_event pe ON ld.loan_account_id = pe.from_account_id
WHERE
    pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
    AND pe.business_date <= date(ld.disbursed_on, '+7 days')
ORDER BY
    interval_days ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        lbs.as_of_date,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        as_of_date,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
),
exposure_calc AS (
    SELECT
        inst.institution_id,
        inst.institution_name,
        pp.display_name AS customer_name,
        lb.principal_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        (lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital) AS ratio
    FROM loan_balance lb
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON lb.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
    JOIN party pp ON lb.borrower_party_id = pp.party_id
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON inst.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        institution_name,
        customer_name,
        ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY ratio DESC) as rn
    FROM exposure_calc
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM RankedLoans
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ins.institution_name,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id) AS total_institution_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN account ca ON ld.loan_account_id = ca.account_id
    JOIN institution ins ON ca.institution_id = ins.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        institution_name,
        principal_balance,
        total_institution_balance,
        ROUND(principal_balance * 100.0 / total_institution_balance, 2) AS ratio_percent,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY institution_name
            ORDER BY principal_balance * 100.0 / total_institution_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_totals
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    institution_name,
    principal_balance,
    ratio_percent
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY institution_name ASC, rn ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.status,
    ds.overdue_principal,
    ds.principal_overdue_days
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE
    ld.status = '正常'
    AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 2
ORDER BY
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC,
    ds.overdue_principal DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT

JOIN

JOIN
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    sm.person_party_id
FROM

WHERE
    sm.employment_status = '在职'
    AND sm.exception_flag = 0
    AND sm.person_party_id NOT IN (

        FROM

    )
ORDER BY
    sm.person_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id
FROM
    account a
WHERE
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND a.account_id NOT IN (
        SELECT
            pe.from_account_id
        FROM

        WHERE
            pe.is_cash = 1
    )
ORDER BY
    a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    gc.status = 'expired'
ORDER BY
    gc.guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        original_maturity_on,
        julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(original_maturity_on) AS remaining_days
    FROM
        loan_drawdown
    WHERE
        original_maturity_on IS NOT NULL
),
classified_loans AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN remaining_days > 90 THEN '常态'
            WHEN remaining_days >= 0 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '已到期'
        END AS bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM
        loan_data
    GROUP BY
        CASE
            WHEN remaining_days > 90 THEN '常态'
            WHEN remaining_days >= 0 THEN '临期'
            ELSE '已到期'
        END
)
SELECT
    bucket,
    cnt
FROM
    classified_loans
ORDER BY
    CASE bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS association_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    sa.status = '有效'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    association_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.collateral_type,
    AVG(cv.valuation_amount) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM
    collateral_valuation cv
JOIN
    collateral_asset c ON cv.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
WHERE
    cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY
    c.collateral_type
ORDER BY
    avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH AccountLoanStats AS (
    SELECT
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT
        als.repayment_account_id,
        als.loan_id,
        als.disbursed_on,
        als.disbursed_amount,
        als.loan_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY als.repayment_account_id ORDER BY als.disbursed_on ASC) AS rn
    FROM AccountLoanStats als
    WHERE als.loan_count >= 3
)
SELECT
    repayment_account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    disbursed_amount,
    loan_count
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY repayment_account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS drawdown_count
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE
    ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    SUM(a.ledger_balance - a.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM
    account a
JOIN
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    a.ledger_balance > a.available_balance
    AND (a.ledger_balance - a.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM
    term_deposit td
JOIN
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
    AND a.status = '正常'
ORDER BY
    td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT
    card_id,
    card_type,
    issued_on
FROM
    payment_card
WHERE
    issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY
    issued_on ASC,
    card_id ASC;

WITH payment_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pe.payment_type = 'entrusted' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pe.payment_type = 'autonomous' THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) AS autonomous_amount
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'success'
      AND pe.is_cash = 0
      AND pe.payment_type IN ('entrusted', 'autonomous')
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ps.entrusted_amount,
    ps.autonomous_amount,
    (ps.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / (ps.entrusted_amount + ps.autonomous_amount)) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM payment_stats ps
JOIN institution i ON ps.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (ps.entrusted_amount + ps.autonomous_amount) > 0
  AND (ps.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / (ps.entrusted_amount + ps.autonomous_amount)) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH contract_total AS (
    SELECT
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM
        loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY
        agreement_id
)
SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS credit_agreement_id,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_drawdown_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS single_disbursement_amount,
    ct.total_disbursed AS total_contract_disbursement,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ct.total_disbursed * 100, 2) AS single_disbursement_ratio_percent
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    contract_total ct ON ld.agreement_id = ct.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / ct.total_disbursed > 0.9
ORDER BY
    ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS total_actual_raise,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_planned_raise,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

WITH borrower_stats AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_loan_count,
        COUNT(rs.loan_id) AS total_loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
    HAVING
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END) > 0
        AND COUNT(rs.loan_id) > COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 END)
),
borrower_info AS (
    SELECT
        bs.borrower_party_id,
        p.display_name AS borrower_name,
        bs.overdue_loan_count,
        bs.total_loan_count
    FROM borrower_stats bs
    JOIN party p ON bs.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
)
SELECT
    bi.borrower_party_id,
    bi.borrower_name,
    bi.overdue_loan_count,
    bi.total_loan_count
FROM borrower_info bi
ORDER BY bi.overdue_loan_count DESC, bi.borrower_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower_party.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee_party.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower_party ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower_party.party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee_party ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee_party.party_id
WHERE
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY
    pi.instruction_amount DESC,
    pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE
    ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE ld.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule
    WHERE status = '已结清'
)
GROUP BY ld.loan_id
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = '核销'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.loan_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.loan_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_subtype = '储蓄'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    ca.security_type = '信用'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY
    ca.contract_amount DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH InstitutionProductAvg AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
RelatedBorrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pr.source_party_id AS borrower_id
    FROM party_relation pr
    WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
),
FilteredAgreements AS (
    SELECT
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ipa.avg_rate AS institution_avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN InstitutionProductAvg ipa
        ON ca.institution_id = ipa.institution_id
        AND ca.product_family = ipa.product_family
    JOIN RelatedBorrowers rb
        ON ca.borrower_party_id = rb.borrower_id
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < ipa.avg_rate
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    fa.annual_interest_rate,
    fa.institution_avg_rate,
    (fa.annual_interest_rate - fa.institution_avg_rate) AS rate_spread
FROM FilteredAgreements fa
JOIN party p
    ON fa.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN party p1 ON pr.source_party_id = p1.party_id
JOIN party p2 ON pr.target_party_id = p2.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld1 ON p1.party_id = ld1.agreement_id -- 这里需要关联到借款人，但loan_drawdown没有直接借款人ID，需通过credit_agreement
JOIN credit_agreement ca1 ON ld1.agreement_id = ca1.agreement_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON p2.party_id = ld2.agreement_id -- 同上
JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
  AND ca1.borrower_party_id = p1.party_id
  AND ca2.borrower_party_id = p2.party_id
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

WITH group_loan_balances AS (
    SELECT
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
    JOIN risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id AND eg.exposure_group_id = re.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON re.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
    HAVING member_count >= 2
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs
        WHERE cs.institution_id = gc.institution_id
    )
)
SELECT
    glb.group_name,
    glb.member_count,
    glb.total_principal_balance,
    ic.net_capital,
    glb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital AS ratio
FROM group_loan_balances glb
JOIN institution_capital ic ON glb.institution_id = ic.institution_id
WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
  AND glb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder payer_holder ON from_acc.account_id = payer_holder.account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer_holder.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN account_holder payee_holder ON to_acc.account_id = payee_holder.account_id
JOIN party payee ON payee_holder.party_id = payee.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (payer.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND payee.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
    OR (payee.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND payer.party_id = pr.target_party_id)
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM
    wealth_product wp
    INNER JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
    INNER JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE
    wp.risk_level = 'R5'
    AND wp.status = '在售'
    AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    COUNT(pa.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM
    wealth_product wp
JOIN
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE
    phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY
    wp.product_id
ORDER BY
    asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    ldd.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_drawdown ldd
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ldd.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ldd.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lbs.overdue_principal IS NOT NULL
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ldd.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, ldd.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id
    AND re.exposure_type = 'LOAN'
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON egm.party_id = re.obligor_party_id AND re.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON re.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH borrower_loans AS (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_guarantees AS (
    SELECT
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.guarantor_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
)
SELECT
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    gg.total_guarantee_amount AS total_guarantee,
    bl.total_loan_amount AS total_loan,
    (gg.total_guarantee_amount - bl.total_loan_amount) AS guarantee_liability_difference
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_guarantees gg ON p.party_id = gg.guarantor_party_id
JOIN borrower_loans bl ON p.party_id = bl.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY guarantee_liability_difference DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS employee_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS contract_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = '在职'
GROUP BY
    p.display_name,
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY
    contract_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS "借款人姓名",
    p.party_id AS "客户编号",
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS "本金余额合计",
    pp.annual_income AS "年收入",
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS "倍数"
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.borrower_party_id = p.party_id -- Note: loan_drawdown does not have borrower_party_id directly, need to join via credit_agreement
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot) -- Assuming latest snapshot for current balance
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2
ORDER BY
    "倍数" DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    so.operator_id,
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM
    service_operator so
JOIN
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON so.staff_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE
    so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
GROUP BY
    so.operator_id,
    p.display_name,
    so.authority_level
ORDER BY
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account acc ON ld.loan_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'holder'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_customer_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS repayment_to_income_ratio
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE
    p.party_type = 'PERSON'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    pp.annual_income
ORDER BY
    repayment_to_income_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lp.product_name_zh,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_product_catalog lp ON ca.product_family = lp.product_family
WHERE
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY
    lp.product_name_zh
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH audit_date AS (
    SELECT '2026-06-30' AS base_date
),
term_deposit_stats AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < ad.base_date THEN 1 END) AS overdue_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= ad.base_date AND td.maturity_on <= date(ad.base_date, '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS within_90_days_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date(ad.base_date, '+90 days') THEN 1 END) AS beyond_90_days_count
    FROM term_deposit td
    JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
    CROSS JOIN audit_date ad
    WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    overdue_count,
    within_90_days_count,
    beyond_90_days_count
FROM term_deposit_stats
WHERE overdue_count >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_count DESC, institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM
    organization_unit ou
JOIN
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
JOIN
    account_holder ah1 ON a.account_id = ah1.account_id
JOIN
    account_holder ah2 ON a.account_id = ah2.account_id
WHERE
    ah1.party_id != ah2.party_id
    AND a.account_kind = 'JOINT'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(ls.loan_balance_id) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(ls.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM
    loan_balance_snapshot ls
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE
    ls.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000.0
ORDER BY SUM(rs.principal_due) DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0 END) AS total_overdue_interest
FROM
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY
    overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ls.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM
    institution i
JOIN
    organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
JOIN
    risk_classification rc ON ou.org_unit_id = rc.assessed_org_unit_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
    OR ds.interest_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT ls.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM
    repayment_schedule rs
WHERE
    rs.paid_on IS NULL
    AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY
    rs.principal_due DESC;

WITH institution_credit AS (
    SELECT
        cf.institution_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    GROUP BY cf.institution_id
),
institution_loan_disbursement AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
institution_total_disbursement AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ild.total_disbursed) AS total_disbursement_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN institution_loan_disbursement ild ON ca.agreement_id = ild.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    )
),
combined_data AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_name,
        COALESCE(ic.total_credit_limit, 0) AS total_credit_limit,
        COALESCE(itd.total_disbursement_amount, 0) AS total_disbursement_amount,
        COALESCE(icap.net_capital, 0) AS net_capital,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(icap.net_capital, 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(itd.total_disbursement_amount, 0) * 1.0 / icap.net_capital, 4)
        END AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
    FROM institution i
    LEFT JOIN institution_credit ic ON i.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN institution_total_disbursement itd ON i.institution_id = itd.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN institution_capital icap ON i.institution_id = icap.institution_id
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    total_credit_limit,
    total_disbursement_amount,
    net_capital,
    disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM combined_data
WHERE total_disbursement_amount > net_capital
ORDER BY disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM
    security_agreement sa
JOIN
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE
    gc.status = '有效'
    AND sa.security_type = '保证担保'
GROUP BY
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
HAVING
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh
FROM
    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    status_catalog sc
    ON cf.status = sc.status_code
    AND sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
ORDER BY
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
FROM
    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000.0
ORDER BY
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    facility_type,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    credit_facility
WHERE
    limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY
    facility_type
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY
    record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM
        wealth_product
    WHERE
        status = '在售'
),
group_counts AS (
    SELECT
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM
        ranked_products
    WHERE
        minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY
        group_id
)
SELECT
    group_id,
    product_count
FROM
    group_counts
WHERE
    product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY
    group_id ASC;

SELECT
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM
    credit_facility cf
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE
    cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
    AND ca.payment_mode = '受托支付'
GROUP BY
    cf.facility_id
ORDER BY
    total_credit_limit DESC;

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE
    pi.status = '待执行'
GROUP BY
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY
    instruction_count DESC;

SELECT
    it.name_zh AS instrument_name_zh,
    s.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM
    instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN
    status_catalog s
WHERE
    s.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY
    it.name_zh,
    s.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM
    organization_unit ou
JOIN
    staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
JOIN
    staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE
    sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    staff_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 0
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_count
FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    cg.grade_ordinal = 2
    AND ps.required_amount > 0
    AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount) < 0.5
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    insufficient_provision_count DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS provision_gap_total
FROM
    provision_snapshot p
JOIN
    loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    provision_gap_total DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.ledger_balance, 0)) AS ledger_balance
FROM
    account a
LEFT JOIN
    account_balance_snapshot b ON a.account_id = b.account_id
LEFT JOIN
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE
    a.status = '久悬'
    AND a.account_kind = '储蓄'
    AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY
    ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(pp.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE
    pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM
    managed_asset
WHERE
    is_monitored_sector = 1
GROUP BY
    asset_category_primary
HAVING
    asset_count < 33
ORDER BY
    asset_count DESC,
    asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio

    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
WHERE

GROUP BY
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income
HAVING
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY
    debt_service_ratio DESC,

LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM
    party p
JOIN
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id

    AND pp.employment_sector IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM
    payment_card
WHERE
    card_type = 'DEBIT'
GROUP BY
    status
ORDER BY
    count DESC,
    status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON acc.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id

GROUP BY
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY
    total_amount DESC,
    ou.unit_name ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id

ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM
    payment_event pe
JOIN
    payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id

    pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY

    COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5

    现金交易笔数 DESC,
    金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM
    payment_card
GROUP BY
    holder_party_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY
    card_count DESC,
    holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    ct.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(pe.payment_id), 2) AS avg_transaction_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id OR pe.to_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ct ON pc.card_type = ct.card_type
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND ct.name_zh IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
GROUP BY ct.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_transaction_amount DESC, ct.name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM
    payment_event
WHERE
    status = 'SETTLED'
    AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY
    channel
HAVING
    avg_amount > 11780000
ORDER BY
    avg_amount DESC,
    channel ASC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM
    term_deposit td
JOIN
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
    td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('now')
    AND a.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY
    td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,

SELECT

SELECT

    guarantor.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    agreement.agreement_id,
    ROUND(guarantor_commitment.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(total_disbursed.total_disbursed_amount, 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM
    guarantor_commitment
JOIN
    security_agreement ON guarantor_commitment.security_id = security_agreement.security_id
JOIN
    secured_obligation ON security_agreement.security_id = secured_obligation.security_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement agreement ON secured_obligation.agreement_id = agreement.agreement_id
JOIN
    party guarantor ON guarantor_commitment.guarantor_party_id = guarantor.party_id
JOIN
    (
        SELECT
            loan_drawdown.agreement_id,
            SUM(loan_drawdown.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount
        FROM
            loan_drawdown
        WHERE
            loan_drawdown.status = 'ACTIVE' OR loan_drawdown.status = 'OPEN'
        GROUP BY
            loan_drawdown.agreement_id
    ) total_disbursed ON agreement.agreement_id = total_disbursed.agreement_id
WHERE
    guarantor_commitment.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND guarantor_commitment.guaranteed_amount > total_disbursed.total_disbursed_amount
ORDER BY
    guarantor_commitment.guaranteed_amount DESC,

    ca.contract_amount,

FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ca.status = '有效'
  AND sa.status = '有效'
GROUP BY
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ca.contract_amount
HAVING coverage_gap > 0
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC

SELECT

    lbs.principal_balance AS loan_balance,
    ca.contract_amount AS credit_limit,

FROM
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id

WITH InternalMax AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal_value
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE appraiser_kind = 'internal'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
),
ExternalMax AS (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external_value
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE appraiser_kind = 'external'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
)
SELECT
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(em.max_external_value, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(im.max_internal_value - em.max_external_value, 2) AS difference
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN InternalMax im ON c.collateral_id = im.collateral_id
JOIN ExternalMax em ON c.collateral_id = em.collateral_id
WHERE im.max_internal_value > em.max_external_value
ORDER BY (im.max_internal_value - em.max_external_value) DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (

    FROM collateral_valuation cv
),
effective_pledges AS (
    SELECT
        cl.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl.pledged_amount) as total_pledged_amount
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = '有效'
    GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
)
SELECT

    ca.asset_label,
    lv.valuation_amount,

FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON ca.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id AND lv.rn = 1
JOIN effective_pledges ep ON ca.collateral_id = ep.collateral_id
WHERE lv.valuation_amount < ep.total_pledged_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

WITH guarantor_totals AS (

    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_loan_exposure AS (
    SELECT
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (

SELECT

    ROUND(gt.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(ble.total_loan_principal, 0), 2) AS excess_guarantee_amount
FROM guarantor_totals gt
JOIN party p ON gt.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_loan_exposure ble ON gt.guarantor_party_id = ble.borrower_party_id
WHERE gt.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(ble.total_loan_principal, 0)

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    g.guaranteed_amount,
    g.status
FROM
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN
    loan_drawdown l ON g.guarantor_party_id = l.borrower_party_id -- 假设 borrower_party_id 在 loan_drawdown 中，但 schema 中 loan_drawdown 没有 borrower_party_id，只有 agreement_id。
                     -- 需要关联 credit_agreement 来获取 borrower_party_id
JOIN
    credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE
    lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    AND g.effective_to IS NULL -- 有效保证
    AND g.status = 'Active' -- 假设有效状态为 Active，根据常见业务逻辑，若 schema 中 status 字段含义不同需调整，此处假设 'Active' 或类似表示有效。
    -- 注意：schema 中 guarantor_commitment 没有直接的状态字段表示“有效”，通常通过 effective_to IS NULL 和 status 判断。
    -- 题目要求“有效保证”，通常指未过期且状态正常。
    -- 另外，题目说“逾期指保证人自己作为借款人名下的借据存在本金逾期”，所以需要检查保证人（guarantor_party_id）是否有逾期的贷款。
    -- loan_drawdown 表没有 borrower_party_id，需要通过 credit_agreement 关联。
    -- credit_agreement 有 borrower_party_id。
    -- 所以路径是: guarantor_commitment -> party (guarantor) -> credit_agreement (borrower) -> loan_drawdown -> loan_balance_snapshot
    -- 但是 loan_drawdown 和 credit_agreement 是一对多吗？通常一个协议对应多个提款。
    -- 我们需要找出保证人作为借款人的任何一笔贷款存在逾期。

    -- 修正关联逻辑：
    -- 1. 找到所有保证人 (guarantor_party_id)
    -- 2. 找到这些保证人作为借款人 (borrower_party_id) 的信用协议 (credit_agreement)
    -- 3. 找到这些协议下的提款 (loan_drawdown)
    -- 4. 检查这些提款是否有逾期本金 (loan_balance_snapshot.overdue_principal > 0)
    -- 5. 输出保证人的担保信息

    -- 由于一个保证人可能有多笔担保，且可能有多笔逾期贷款，我们需要确保至少有一笔逾期贷款存在。
    -- 使用 EXISTS 或者 JOIN 去重。

    -- 重新构建查询：
    -- 从 guarantor_commitment 开始
    -- 关联 party 获取名称
    -- 使用 EXISTS 检查该保证人是否有逾期贷款

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    g.guaranteed_amount,
    g.status
FROM
    guarantor_commitment g
JOIN
    party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE
    g.effective_to IS NULL
    AND g.status = 'Active' -- 假设 Active 为有效状态，若 schema 中 status 枚举不同，请根据实际情况调整，例如 'VALID'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        JOIN loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
          AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    )
ORDER BY
    g.guaranteed_amount DESC,
    g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    SUM(lds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM
    product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.asset_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lds ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
WHERE
    phs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM product_holding_snapshot)
    AND lds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    AND lds.overdue_principal > 0
    AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lds2 ON ld2.loan_id = lds2.loan_id
        WHERE lds2.overdue_principal > 0
          AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
    )
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY
    wp.product_name ASC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
